description: No edge found: opening imbalance decay rate has no predictive power for 5m BTC Up/Down market outcomes. All correlations near zero (max ±0.02), win rates 48-54% regardless of parameters.
hypothesis: Opening auction imbalance decay rate: Measure how fast the bid-ask imbalance at market open (first 2s) mean-reverts over the next 10-20s. Slow decay = informed flow (trade with it), fast reversion = noise (fade it).

analysis_details.decay_ratio_finding: Fast decay (Q25) WR=54.8% vs slow decay (Q75) WR=49.0% — opposite of hypothesis
analysis_details.simple_direction_0-2s: Follow WR=48.4%, Fade WR=51.6% — neither survives fees

next_steps: Opening book imbalance is noise in 5m BTC markets — MMs reprice too fast for initial imbalance to carry information. More promising: (1) trade flow from trade_events, (2) cross-market momentum, (3) external BTC price in first seconds.
